notes.title: Sounds of Her Love 2 - Coming June 20th!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28073357/009314625b0906b97189f904cdd49eb0431028a6.png"][/img][/p][p]"Leopards don't change their spots that easily... A tender, wholesome love story awaits."

Sounds of Her Love 2 is finally here! We'll be releasing next week, on June 20th!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3427740/Sounds_of_Her_Love_2/"][/dynamiclink]
Thank you all for joining us on our journey, not only over the last 2 years of SOHL 2's development, but over the last 8 since we first released Sounds of Her Love. When setting out on its development, I never imagined that the game would receive anywhere near the amount of love it had, let alone getting to the point where we'd be able to make a sequel.

Sounds of Her Love 2 is a story about growth and overcoming challenges - the ones we decide to tackle ourselves and those which are forced upon us unexpectedly. I hope this has been translated well through Sounds of Her Love 2, and we will continue to work on projects with the talented people who've made it possible.

Thank you all for the support.

- ds-sans

notes.title: Sounds of Her Love 2 - Devlog #4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28073357/c9d9be04993e459fe63c1930b287bf341c92cf74.png[/img]

[i]They're just having a bit of fun![/i]

Work on Sounds of Her Love 2 has continued! After all the fun of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/603880/view/4125931766227035946]our anniversary[/url], we've pushed forward to make more progress on the game in the last couple of months! So, of course, what better way to celebrate our continued motivation than by sharing new updates with everyone!

It is always a pleasure stopping by, and the support really means a lot to us. Sounds of Her Love 2 is shaping up to be one of our most enjoyable titles yet, so I'm really pleased that this train shows no sign of slowing down. Thank you all!

In terms of updates, things are now in full-swing adding in our voice cast to the game. In addition to [url=https://x.com/AmberBarileVO]Amber Barile[/url] playing the lovely Ceri, I am also pleased to announce the following talents who'll be joining the music club as our side cast!

[list]
[*] [url=https://x.com/leaderlooi]Leader Looi[/url] as Nonoka Ibaraki - the passionate oboist and leader of the music club!
[*] [url=https://x.com/xShellah]Shellah[/url] as Emma McCollough - the approachable and upbeat violinist aka the 'friendly face' of the club.
[*] [url=https://x.com/mjluvoices]MJ Lu[/url] as Iroha Makise - the self-described 'sensible' one, often taking a backseat on antics to practice the flute.
[/list]
We've been sharing short snippets of their performances over on X/Twitter, but we've compiled a selection below of all our voice talents to give you a feel as to how the game will pan out!

[previewyoutube=rZh38WBHjuU;full][/previewyoutube]

This is, of course, compounded by new art updates by [url=https://x.com/kimiyotosan]Kimiyoto[/url], who's been doing fantastic work on new CGs (including the cute chibi ones seen above) and, as you might have noticed, a developing soundtrack by [url=https://x.com/redrobotix]Red Robotix[/url]!

For a game with such a heavy emphasis on music - it's important for us to have a well-suited soundtrack. Red has been doing an amazing job with this, and we're looking forward to sharing more samples of his work in the upcoming months!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28073357/9779b21e25cc2e2281c395fba9417183bcf12bf5.png[/img]

I'm really happy with the direction the game is heading in, so I hope you will all enjoy it too! Working with [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/ebi-hime]ebi-hime[/url] to co-write the game's script has also been a huge motivation and really polished this cast of characters further than I could imagine. Many of the most memorable, light-hearted scenes with the music club members are her doing, and working with the great cast of VAs listed above, it really has breathed a new energy into this project.

(Of course, the cute lovey-dovey scenes with Ceri haven't gone anywhere either).

Thank you all for your support once again! It was a short one this time, but we will be back soon with more updates in due course. I don't want to fall into oversharing too much of the game, there's plenty of stuff we have firmly under wraps which, I hope, will be a big surprise and receive just as much love as what we've been able to share so far.

Of course, more updates are available over on our [url=https://x.com/dssansVN]X/Twitter[/url], so please check us out there too! Thank you!

notes.title: SOHL Achievements + Summer Fun!
notes.content:
So we finally caved to the pressure...

Ever since Sounds of Her Love came out, you all have been asking for achievements. While I never really thought they were necessary, I think it's about time to breathe a new lease of life into the game and bring back some old and new Ceri fans to the WISJ (she probably misses you too).

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/YqGBPn9Y/Capture.png[/img]

Now that's that, you should go back and give Ceri some love.

In other news... it's summer! And that means, cute girls doing cute things discounted for 50% off! ICYMI: We released a commercial VN last year - original assets, full voice acting, cute girls - Ceri even shows up too! If you like our work and you're interested in supporting us, you can get 'Chemically Bonded' for $4.99 for the next two weeks:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/734900/Chemically_Bonded/

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/HWsCHWSw-/sale1.png[/img]

Besides that, as always, [url=https://twitter.com/dssansVN]we're really active over on Twitter[/url]. We're working on a new game, 'Thawing Feelings', which we'll be posting more about soon.

Stay safe and stay cute!

- ds-sans

notes.title: Our new visual novel out now! - Chemically Bonded
notes.content:
From what we've seen in your reviews, comments and feedback - many of you would've been willing to pay for Sounds of Her Love. While we couldn't do that due to copyright issues with some of the assets used in SOHL, the next best thing is to make a new game from scratch: double the girls, triple the playtime, and everything handcrafted with love...

...a game like that would certainly be nice, right?

If you haven't been living under a rock for the past two years, we've already done that!

Chemically Bonded is out now! A story following two estranged girls and your attempts to restore their friendship. Made with love, everything is fresh off the press and we're able to sell it to you for the cheap price of $9.99.

The game contains:
[list]
[*] Multiple routes and endings - ~9 hrs gameplay.
[*] Interactive phone system for choices and dates.
[*] 5+ outfits and multiple poses for both girls.
[*] High quality artwork.
[*] Full Voice Acting
[*] Genre: Romance, Drama, Comedy
[*] Romance: B x G
[/list]

Check Chemically Bonded out now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/734900/

If you enjoyed Sounds of Her Love, we know you'll enjoy our latest visual novel. Ceri even makes a brief cameo appearance! If that isn't enough of an incentive, I don't know what is. 

We hope to see you in the Science Club soon! [url=https://twitter.com/dssansVN]You can also follow us on Twitter here for future updates.[/url]
